dimensions.name: contract
dimensions.question: Is behavior represented by a stable typed contract and semantic owner?

dimensions.name: reference
dimensions.question: Does a deterministic simple reference implementation exist?

dimensions.name: positive_path
dimensions.question: Has the intended success path completed with retained evidence?

dimensions.name: conformance
dimensions.question: Does standards/differential conformance pass with divergences classified?

dimensions.name: determinism
dimensions.question: Do replay, tie-break, and output digests reproduce?

dimensions.name: cancellation
dimensions.question: Are cancellation, obligations, drain, and quiescence qualified?

dimensions.name: crash_recovery
dimensions.question: Are publication kill points and recovery outcomes qualified?

dimensions.name: security
dimensions.question: Are authority, secrets, input bounds, sandboxing, and supply chain qualified?

dimensions.name: privacy
dimensions.question: Are filtering, masks, retention, export, and deletion closure qualified?

dimensions.name: performance
dimensions.question: Are same-binary workload distributions and complexity witnesses retained?

dimensions.name: quality
dimensions.question: Are event/task quality, calibration, and statistical confidence retained?

dimensions.name: compatibility
dimensions.question: Are exact device, firmware, app, platform, model, and protocol tuples certified?

dimensions.name: retrievability
dimensions.question: Can advertised roots be independently reconstructed and repaired?

dimensions.name: operability
dimensions.question: Do doctor, replay, support-bundle, repair, migration, and rollback work?

dimensions.name: documentation
dimensions.question: Do docs, schemas, registries, code, claims, and receipts agree?

dimensions.name: release_custody
dimensions.question: Did clean-source local target qualification, signing, publication, and download verification pass?
